title: Catch of the Day — Pelican Pedal Express
description: A great white pelican pedals a cobalt bicycle, wings clasping the handlebars, webbed feet on opposite pedals and a fish peeking from its enormous orange bill. Spoked wheels, a brass bell, a rear luggage rack and a compact transparent parking support finish the sculpture.

sections.name: Rounded white body and black tipped tail
Expressive head with two printed eyes
Deep throat pouch and long tapered bill
